title: Stuck, asks for hints, then writes the proof
question: When the learner needs help, does the tutor keep their work and count the hints while translating?
turns: I'm stuck. All I have is x = 2a. What do I do next? Give me a hint.
Still stuck. Give me the next hint.
OK, here is my work: x = 2a. x^2 = 4a^2. 4a^2 = 2(2a^2). So the witness is 2a^2.
